note: Method registry. `status` governs PUBLIC rendering: a method's output may be shown on Desk pages only when status is ACTIVE. `internal` governs the private research engines (desk/_tools/engines): ACTIVE means implemented, documented and tested, with results kept in the private store and never exported. `publication` states what may ever become public. No method may be added or activated without an approved, documented methodology (D-20).

methods.name: Evidence classification and verification
methods.basis: Master Context; Handoff §5; Schema v1.1

methods.name: Research Closure and Data Completeness
methods.basis: Handoff §5

methods.name: Missing-data states
methods.basis: Handoff §5

methods.name: Documented risk list (qualitative, no score)
outputs: risk list: type, cause, evidence, horizon, controllability, mitigation, residual uncertainty
methods.basis: Handoff §4; Spec v1 §4

methods.name: Risk severity and likelihood labels
methods.basis: Spec v1 §4 requires a severity method that is not yet defined

methods.name: Opportunity and media publication gate
methods.basis: Handoff §6; G0; gate G3-v1

methods.name: Market publication gate
methods.approved: owner instruction 28 Oct 2026 (audit K-1: approve MG-1 rules); reversible by setting status INACTIVE
methods.basis: Shared engine MGE-1 with per-market configuration MG-1 (Istanbul, Dubai, Abu Dhabi): desk/_tools/market-gates/MG-1.json, documented in desk/_tools/MARKET-GATES.md. Rules approved by the owner (28 Oct 2026). A market becomes ACTIVE only through activate-market when its own computed gate passes, and reaches the public site only through export-market with its gate certificate (D11/D12). Setting this entry INACTIVE again closes every real market (V21). Owner decisions D1 (three-market programme) and D3.

methods.name: Asset Quality assessment
methods.basis: Spec v1 §5, §10 (dimensions and scoring open)

methods.name: Investment Fit (qualitative criteria)
methods.basis: FIT-1: explicit criteria (objective, market, delivery status, horizon, excluded risk types, budget from private price evidence) each MATCH / NO_MATCH / CANNOT_CONFIRM; no score, weight or ranking. Public output prohibited (D-03).

methods.name: District and area ranking
methods.basis: D-03; Spec v1 §4

methods.name: Budget eligibility from internal price evidence
methods.basis: D-02, D-06; implemented as the budget criterion of FIT-1 (lowest recorded price vs budget, same currency only)

methods.name: Fair value
methods.basis: D-03; Spec v1 §4. Not implemented: no adjustment model. M-COMPARABLES summarises unadjusted comparables internally and never produces a fair value.

methods.name: Public rental yield and return figures
methods.basis: D-03; Spec v1 §4. Public yield/return figures prohibited in the MVP. This entry governs PUBLIC figures only. The internal calculations (cash flow, ROI, NPV, IRR, net rental yield of the first rented year, real-terms and home-currency views) exist as M-CASHFLOW, M-ROI, M-NPV, M-SCENARIOS and M-RETURN-VIEWS (FIN-2) and are never published (D10).

methods.name: Liquidity assessment
methods.basis: Handoff §5: transaction depth is not liquidity

methods.name: Liquidity and exit review (qualitative)
outputs: supporting / weakening evidence, DATA NOT AVAILABLE list
methods.basis: No rating or estimate; transaction depth is context, not liquidity (M-LIQUIDITY stays inactive)

methods.name: Opportunity comparison and research queue
outputs: rule-based class from the gate's structured reason codes
methods.basis: Explicit classes and a work-planning order (fewest open items first); not an investment ranking

methods.name: Structured domain assessment (market, location, project, developer)
outputs: evidence and research status per intelligence domain (decision report)
methods.basis: Groups evidence by domain with its classification and research status; adds no judgement, score or rating. Public pages already show the same evidence and research status.

methods.name: Currency and unit conversion
outputs: converted values with rate, date and source
methods.basis: Explicit dated rates only (no live, cross or future rates; maximum age); m² ↔ ft² exact; gross ↔ net never converted.

methods.name: Comparable selection and price-per-m² summary (unadjusted)
outputs: eligible set, exclusions with reasons, median and interquartile range, or INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE
methods.basis: One price type at a time; same area basis; same district by default; maximum age; minimum sample ≥ 3 (set per analysis); no adjustments; never a fair value. Public price figures prohibited (D-02, D-03).

methods.name: Cash-flow model (unlevered, annual)
methods.basis: End-of-year flows, t = 0 at valuation; every input with recorded provenance; missing input → UNAVAILABLE; financing unsupported.

methods.name: Return on investment (total, unlevered, undiscounted)
outputs: ROI = Σ CF / total invested; net rental yield reported separately
methods.basis: Verified against hand calculation and a second implementation.

methods.name: Net present value
methods.basis: Σ CF_t/(1+r)^t; the rate is never taken from a mortgage rate, inflation or a default; verified by Horner evaluation and textbook cases.

methods.name: IRR, real-terms and home-currency return views
inputs: recorded FX spot and path with basis
methods.basis: Audit 28 Oct 2026 (P1-4): nominal TRY returns overstate the result; each view runs only on recorded inputs with a written basis; hand-checked cases.

methods.name: Base, favourable and adverse scenarios
outputs: cash flows, ROI, NPV per scenario
methods.basis: Each scenario computed from its own complete inputs; an incomplete scenario is UNAVAILABLE on its own. Not forecasts.

methods.name: Decision report (traceable, internal)
methods.basis: Every line cites record IDs; findings need evidence; no score, ranking or buy recommendation; written only to the private store.
